Two bedrooms, two full baths, two parking spots.

10459 Des Moines Memorial Dr S #303 is an updated condo in Boulevard Park with newer floors, fresh paint and a private deck, so you can move right in. The living and dining areas flow together, and the laundry room is just down the hall.

It sits near Rainier Golf and Country Club, with quick access to commuter routes, shopping, dining, parks, the water and the airport.

Want to see it in person? Send me a message and I’ll set up a private showing. Every photo is at homes.ranchpnw.com/10459.
